tasks.short: Monitor bonding machinery and handle problems

steps.what: Monitor machine operations and assess observed signs of malfunction
Report problems or resolve them within established operating authority

tasks.design: Keep live malfunction detection and response with the operator. Existing {OPS_SYSTEM} indications, {DOCS} and {TELEPHONY} support observation and escalation without a new automatic diagnostic or control layer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fault signs depend on actual machine behavior and material conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controls and communication support trained response.
tasks.still_hard: Separate a normal variation from a fault requiring intervention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize unusual physical behavior and act within competence.
tasks.altitude: Own attentive operation and clear fault escalation.

evidence.claim: Malfunction observation and response retain their human time without a validated fault-detection design.

assumptions: No validated fault sensor, diagnosis rule or automatic repair capability is established.
The operator retains existing intervention limits and escalates other work.
Existing tools remain and no additional automation maintenance is introduced.
Routine instrument reading belongs to the separate gauge-observation task; this task owns malfunction assessment and response, with no duplicated saving.
research_questions: What repeated information-gathering work exists outside required physical fault assessment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Fault assessment and response remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret work orders and agree settings

steps.what: Read work orders to identify product, supply and equipment setup requirements
Communicate with coworkers to resolve requirements and determine appropriate settings and adjustments

tasks.design: The operator interprets current work orders in {DOCS} and discusses ambiguities with coworkers. No automatic recipe selection is assumed merely because some specifications appear in a document.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions may omit context about materials and machine condition.
tasks.enabler_now: Current documents support a shared interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicts between instructions and actual production conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a nominal specification needs clarification.
tasks.altitude: Own a correct shared understanding before setup.

evidence.claim: Work-order interpretation and setup discussion retain full time absent validated recipe rules.

assumptions: The task covers understanding and agreement, not an invented repeated transcription phase.
Physical setup is downstream and receives no saving here.
Existing documents suffice, with no new tool or upkeep.
unknowns: Order consistency and availability of validated recipes
research_questions: Do recurring orders contain stable fields that native recipe lookup could present without concealing ambiguity?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Reading, technical judgement and coworker discussion remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe gauges, meters and control panels for temperatures, pressures and feeder or conveyor speeds

tasks.design: Retain direct instrument observation through existing {OPS_SYSTEM} controls. No accessible digital telemetry, validated replacement display or reduction of required operator attention is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings must be understood in actual machine context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing gauges provide information for trained observation.
tasks.still_hard: Notice an implausible reading or a mismatch with physical behavior.
tasks.human_edge: Connect instrument information with what the equipment is doing.

evidence.claim: Physical instrument observation retains time without an established equivalent telemetry design.

assumptions: Existing gauge runtime already occurs and earns no new labour saving.
No new instrumentation, alarm logic or control action is proposed.
Fault evaluation and response belong to the separate malfunction task; this task owns routine reading only.
No additional automation maintenance is required.
unknowns: Instrument connectivity and required observation routine
research_questions: Would validated native telemetry remove travel or repeated transcription while preserving necessary physical observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Required instrument observation remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture quantities, dimensions and thicknesses of materials processed with job and unit references
Maintain material production records from captured entries without duplicate copying
Check material production records and resolve measurement or quantity discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure a single material record in {OPS_SYSTEM} for manually captured quantities and dimensions. Saving the entry retains the record without recopying; measurement, identity checks and quality decisions stay with people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material measurements may be copied from a local sheet into another production record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record forms can retain one captured material entry.
tasks.still_hard: Associate actual measurements with the correct material and job.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an implausible measurement or mixed-batch record.
tasks.altitude: Own traceable material records with less repeated copying.

evidence.claim: Critical Manufacturing MES supports defect capture and production-process records in semiconductor manufacturing; this does not establish this bonding-machine form or its labour saving.
Single-entry recording can avoid a second transcription after manual measurement and capture.

assumptions: The operator produces job ID, batch, material ID, observation time, quantity, dimension values, thickness, units and measurement source in s1; its 50 hours includes measurement, counting and capture.
No machine feed, accepted-quality flag or defect code is assumed; unclear units or material identity return to manual investigation in s3.
Use native production-record configuration before custom code.
Six focal and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover field definitions, exceptions and system support.
This is material quantity and dimension recording; instrument observation and fault response remain in their separate tasks with no duplicated saving.
Applicable employee consultation and access checks are included in rollout; records are not used to rank operators.
research_questions: Does one captured material entry remove enough repeated copying after physical measurement and record checks remain?

already_counted.description: Material measurement, counting and structured capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 6 focal upkeep gives central net 19%. Range 0-10% allows physical capture burden and uncertain duplicate copying; already single-entry records save zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own attentive bonding-machine operation and traceable material records.
reach: Help production supervisors clarify operating problems
Support inspectors with reconciled material measurements
role.ambitious_version: An operator who records measured material facts once while retaining live equipment observation, coworker coordination and fault judgement.
